flow: 3, 2, 1, Go… Beginning under the rig, Athletes will advance to the ski erg on the opposite side of the floor and perform 21 calories on the ski erg.
After completing all calories on the ski erg, Athletes will then advance to their barbell and perform 21 front squats.
After completion of 21 front squats, Athletes will then move to the rig and complete the prescribed gymnastics movement.
After completion of the first round of gymnastics, athletes will move back to the ski erg to start the round of 15, followed by the round of 9.
The athletes’ time will be recorded when they cross the finish line by located directly in front of the finish mat.
3, 2, 1, Go… Athlete will begin the prescribed number of double unders. Once complete, they will move to the dumbbell, and lunge 25’ down the floor with the dumbbell in the overhead position.

Once the athlete has crossed the 25’ mark, they will set the dumbbell down on the turf and begin 20 dumbbell facing burpees over the dumbbell. Once all 20 burpees are complete, the athlete will return the dumbbell to the overhead position and lunge another 25’ towards the start mat.
They may then begin round 2. Three total rounds will be completed with time counted when the athlete crosses the finish line onto their start mat.

divisions.name: Elite
lines: 3 Shuttle runs (1 rep = 50 ft out/50 ft back)

divisions.name: RX
lines: 3 Shuttle runs (1 rep = 50 ft out/50 ft back)

divisions.name: Intermediate/ Masters 40+/ Masters 50+/ Teens/ Scaled
lines: 3 Shuttle runs (1 rep = 50 ft out/50 ft back)

flow: 3, 2, 1, Go… Athlete will move from behind the EVENT START/FINISH line to their sandbag and perform 10 sandbag to shoulder .

They will then perform three 50ft shuttle runs (300ft in total). A pylon will be placed 50ft from the SHUTTLE RUN START/FINISH LINE – athletes will run 50ft to the pylon, going around, and 50ft back to the SHUTTLE RUN START/FINISH LINE , which will be 1 repetition.
After completion of 3 shuttle runs, athletes will then perform 8 sandbag to shoulder, and another 3 shuttles.
This will continue in descending rep scheme – 6, 4, 2 – with final time being recorded when athlete returns to the EVENT START/FINISH line after their final 3 shuttles runs.

divisions.name: All divisions
lines: Athletes will have 12 minutes to establish a 1 rep max snatch. Any variation of snatch is allowed.

1.format: For Time · 2 rounds (each partnership) for time:
flow: 3, 2, 1, Go… Athletes 1 & 2 will advance from the start mat to the barbell and complete 20 power cleans, split as desired.
After 20 power cleans, Athletes 1 & 2 will advance to the burpee box jump/step overs, completing 15 repetitions.
After 15 Burpee Box Jump/Step Overs, the Athletes 1 & 2 will advance to the rig and complete the Bar Muscle Ups/Pull Ups/Ring Rows, split as desired.
After the Bar Muscle Ups/Pull Ups/Ring Rows, the pair will complete 20 Toes to Bar/Knee Raises.
Upon completion of the Toes to Bar/Knee Raises, Athletes 1&2 will return to the start mat at the other end of the floor, signaling the release of Athletes 3 & 4.
Athletes 3 & 4 will advance from the start mat to the rig, completing the work in reverse order.
After completion of the 20 power cleans, athletes 3 & 4 will move onto the start mat, releasing athletes 1 & 2 for their second round.
Round 2 for both pairs will be completed in the same fashion.
Time is complete when athletes 3 & 4 cross the finish line onto their start mats for the second time.
*Coed teams will complete the work in same-sex pairs
3,2,1 go… Athlete 1 will move from their start mat, across the floor to the ski erg and complete prescribed calories.
Once complete, they will move to the dumbbells where they will complete 25ft of double dumbbell walking lunges towards the start mat – any position is allowed for dumbbells.
Once they have completed 25ft of double dumbbell walking lunges, they will perform the prescribed number of double dumbbell thrusters, before lunging another 25ft towards the ski erg.
Once they have crossed the 25ft line, they will sprint back to the start mat, releasing athlete 2.
This will continue in the same flow for athletes 2, 3, and 4. Time will be counted when athlete 4 returns to the start mat.
*Coed team order will be Female, Female, Male, Male.

3,2,1 go… Athletes 1&2 will move from event start/finish line to begin the 200 ft Sandbag Carry. Athletes will move together, 50ft down their lane, around a pylon, and 50ft back until 200ft has been completed. The Sandbag Carry may be split as needed.
Then they will perform 20 Sandbag to shoulder. The Sandbag to Shoulder may be split as needed.

After completion of the Sandbag to shoulder, athletes 1 & 2 will advance the sandbag to the next repetition marker and return to the event start/finish line , releasing athletes 3 & 4 to begin their 200ft Sandbag Carry and 20 Sandbag to shoulder.
This flow will continue in the same fashion for the round of 200ft Sandbag Carry and 15 Sandbag to shoulder as well as the 200ft Sandbag Carry and 10 Sandbag to shoulder rounds.
Final time will be called when athletes 3 & 4 complete the 10 Sandbag to shoulder, and all 4 athletes cross the event start/finish line .

notes: Coed pairs will be same sex.
Each lane will have one men's bar and one women’s bar.
Same sex pairs will share one barbell.
All 4 athletes can assist in loading/unloading the barbell.

divisions.name: All divisions
lines: The final score will be total weight. Partner 1 & 2 combined highest weight successfully lifted plus Partner 3 & 4 combined highest weight successfully lifted.

flow: 3, 2, 1… GO, Athletes 1 & 2 will have 6 mins to establish a 1RM Snatch. They will work together, on the same barbell, working in lifts as needed.
There will be a 1-minute transition to Athletes 3 & 4.
Athletes 3 & 4 will then have 6 minutes to establish a complex of 1 snatch + 1 overhead squat. They will work together, on the same barbell, working in lifts as needed.
